thingsToDo.title: Rozafa Castle
thingsToDo.description: Perched on a rocky hill with views across Lake Shkodër and three rivers. Best visited an hour before sunset for the golden lighting across the valleys.
thingsToDo.alt: View from Rozafa Castle in Shkoder

thingsToDo.title: The Pedonale (Kole Idromeno)
thingsToDo.description: The lively Venetian-style pedestrian street starting right outside the hostel. Lined with independent cafes, restaurants, and evening promenades.
thingsToDo.alt: Walking down the Pedonale in Shkoder

thingsToDo.title: Lake Shkodër & Shiroka
thingsToDo.description: Grab a bike and cycle out past the Buna bridge to the sleepy village of Shiroka. Stop for fresh carp by the water and a clear view of the Montenegrin mountains.
thingsToDo.alt: Biking along Lake Shkoder towards Shiroka

thingsToDo.title: Marubi National Photography Museum
thingsToDo.description: A quiet, modern exhibition featuring over 150 years of Albanian history through the incredibly detailed lenses of the Marubi family.
thingsToDo.alt: Inside the Marubi National Photography Museum

thingsToDo.title: Mesi Bridge (Ura e Mesit)
thingsToDo.description: A stunning, curved Ottoman bridge resting over the shallow, opal waters of the Kir River, built in 1768 to connect the city with the northern highlands.
thingsToDo.alt: The historic Ottoman Mesi Bridge in Shkoder
